summary: Add closed read-only service admission for receipt/state claims and exact work items; service document namespaces and production issuance remain disabled

replay.detail: No migration; grant storage and digest authentication retain their existing meanings.

schema.detail: No fractal-schema or device pairing changes.

rules.detail: Service bearers on both routers require a registered GET/read-scope pair. Claim bodies use a closed gate-result/work-state field schema; all other kinds are metadata-only. Document scope and routes remain registered but every service document read is refused because the namespace allowlist is empty. Unknown routes, upgrades and mutations are refused before dispatch. Work reads do not acknowledge wakes; daemon-owned read-window audits are bounded per grant.

compatibility.detail: New client claim/work aliases are service-only; existing non-service native reads retain their semantics. Browser ingress refuses mixed admitted-cookie/Authorization requests instead of discarding the bearer. Assistant scopes and disclosure consent are unchanged. Service issuance remains disabled; owner lifecycle and rollout safety remain prerequisites.
